configuration.modernized_iron_shulker_bo: Menu Placements Data Loader Preset ID

Instructs the Menu Placements Data Loader to attempt to load the preset of the specified ID, instead of the default.
New Menu Placements Presets are defined through resource packs in the modernized_iron_shulker_boxes/menu_placements folder.
If the preset has partial or invalid data, the default data will be instead loaded.
